subject: Calendar and capacity
question: Which calendar dates define the week, what is the presentation deadline, and what hours can each person commit?
safe_behavior: Use Day 1 to Day 7 only; do not invent dates or hours.

subject: Demonstration boundaries
question: For each strategy part, approve the working feature, synthetic input and explicitly mocked integration. Must OCR, biometrics, USSD, WhatsApp, preauthorization creation and anomaly scoring work this week?
safe_behavior: Five dimensions remain required. Do not silently omit a dimension or call a mock live.

subject: Technical conventions and API freeze
proposed_coordinators: Tristan/Brian and Obunde with frontend owners
question: Approve modular FastAPI architecture, ORM and migrations, package versions, API paths, response schemas, money representation and repository layout. Is the proposed SRS contract accepted or amended?
blocks: Shared schema, framework setup, clients and implementation contract
safe_behavior: Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI and PostgreSQL are confirmed; other libraries and protocol details are proposed.

subject: Identity and access
question: Choose authentication and session handling. Confirm users and roles, insurer/provider/TPA boundaries, who can approve claims, who can grant consent, and whether approval separation is required.
blocks: Login, authorization, API data filtering and consent ownership
safe_behavior: A role picker is not authentication. Do not issue insecure demo bypasses as live access control.

subject: Data schema and fixture extension
question: Approve required member, claim, policy and service fields; coding systems and provider code mapping; date rules; permitted additional fictional cases and their values.
blocks: Claim forms, validation and nonreference fixtures
safe_behavior: Only Case 001 values are supplied. Missing birth dates, emails, premiums, diagnoses and addresses remain unset.

subject: Financial policy and exceptions
question: Outside Case 001, confirm deductible and coinsurance order, benefit consumption basis, reservation timing, exclusions, rounding, partial approval, reversals and who absorbs each adjustment.
blocks: General calculations, benefit ledger and exception workflow
safe_behavior: Case 001 uses 10% member share and insurer-share benefit consumption. Never apply it universally.

subject: Clinical history and consent
question: Approve history fields, allowed recipients and purposes, how patient action is established, grant expiry, withdrawal behavior and permitted retained records. May underwriting history sharing work in this demo or be a labelled illustration?
blocks: History fixtures, consent UI and authorization checks
safe_behavior: Claims access does not grant underwriting access. No new patient facts or consent grants are invented.

subject: Report definitions and finance inputs
question: Supply approved synthetic earned premiums, incurred claims or reserve inputs, period, scheme, gross/net basis and timestamps. Approve whether loss ratio by hospital/diagnosis/procedure is valid or whether those views show claim costs only.
blocks: Financial fixture, loss ratio and segmented reporting
safe_behavior: Unknown values are null and the metric is unavailable. A benefit limit is not earned premium.

subject: Anomaly and AI scope
revisit_by: Before any AI or anomaly label
question: Select a demonstration method: explained heuristic flags, a clearly mocked model response, or a model with approved data and evaluation. Approve features, thresholds and labels. How is a legitimate repeat procedure distinguished?
blocks: Anomaly service, evaluation and pitch claims
safe_behavior: The strategy mentions a 30-day cross-provider signal, not a fraud verdict or approval to implement a model.

subject: Document handling and external adapters
question: Choose private storage and document limits. Confirm OCR mode and permitted document fixtures. Supply authorized API contracts and credentials for any real integration; otherwise agree mock disclosures.
blocks: Upload handlers, OCR, SHA/DHA, biometrics, WhatsApp and USSD
safe_behavior: Do not invent national IDs, endpoints, biometric records, credentials or upload limits.

subject: Hosting and delivery
question: Where will frontend, API, database and documents run? Confirm repository access, environments, secrets, audience, hostname and who can publish. Does Kenya hosting apply to the synthetic demo environment or only the real-data pilot?
blocks: Deployment, CORS, DNS, CI and network access
safe_behavior: Prepare environment examples with placeholders; do not choose a paid provider or publish real data.

subject: Acceptance and presentation
question: Who signs off the demonstration? What is the pitch duration, audience and required format? Confirm browsers, viewport needs, load and response-time targets and minimum evidence for all five dimensions.
blocks: Final acceptance, performance thresholds and pitch length
safe_behavior: No invented numerical benchmarks or presentation length.

subject: Business and pilot agreements
question: Confirm target buyer, pilot partner, provider participation, pricing, savings baseline, attribution and dispute ownership.
safe_behavior: The week delivers a demonstration, not a signed pilot, market validation or measured savings.

subject: Real data governance
proposed_coordinators: Team with qualified legal and domain advisers; Silas records
question: Confirm controller/processor roles, lawful bases and confidentiality obligations, retention and transfer rules, ODPC steps, DHA classification/certification and insurer-specific requirements.
blocks: Any real data, real identity integration or production deployment
safe_behavior: Synthetic-only policy remains active. Do not claim legal compliance, certification or regulator approval.
